import numpy as np

def dynamics(t, x, u):
    i_L = x[0]  # inductor current (A)
    V_out = x[1]  # output voltage (V)
    D = u[0]  # duty cycle (0 to 1)
    R_load = 48.0  # load resistance (ohm)
    ESR_L = 0.1  # inductor ESR (ohm)
    ESR_C = 0.05  # capacitor ESR (ohm)
    V_in = 12.0  # input voltage (V)
    L = 0.001  # inductor value (H)
    C = 0.0001  # capacitor value (F)

    # Boost converter dynamics
    di_L_dt = (V_in - V_out - ESR_L * i_L) / L  # inductor current change (A/s)
    dV_out_dt = (D * V_in - V_out / R_load - ESR_C * V_out) / C  # output voltage change (V/s)

    dx = np.array([di_L_dt, dV_out_dt])
    return dx
